items.exampleEn: The shop sells a diverse range of teas.
items.exampleZh: 這家店賣各式各樣的茶。

items.exampleEn: Long, cold winters characterize this region.
items.exampleZh: 漫長寒冷的冬天是這個地區的特色。

items.exampleEn: My uncle has a stable job at a bank.
items.exampleZh: 我舅舅在銀行有一份穩定的工作。

items.exampleEn: She drove at a steady speed.
Not being invited to the party felt like a slight.
items.exampleZh: 沒被邀請參加派對，感覺像是受到了輕視。

items.exampleEn: Look at the problem from another angle.
items.exampleZh: 從另一個角度看這個問題。

items.exampleEn: An efficient worker can finish this job in an hour.
items.exampleZh: 有效率的工人一小時就能完成這份工作。

items.sentenceEn: The weather has been stable this week.

items.audioEn: Our new bus system is more efficient: buses now come every five minutes.
items.audioZh: 我們的新公車系統更有效率：現在每五分鐘就有一班公車。
items.questionZh: 新的公車系統有什麼改變？
options: The buses are much bigger now.
Buses now come every fifteen minutes.
The drivers are much nicer now.

items.sentenceEn: The town has a steady flow of visitors all year.
items.sentenceZh: 小鎮一年到頭都有穩定的遊客人潮。

items.sentenceEn: Please fill in the form properly.

items.stemEn: The ladder isn't ____, so please hold it while I climb.
items.stemZh: 梯子不穩，我爬上去的時候請扶著。

items.stemEn: From this ____, the building looks like a giant ship.
items.stemZh: 從這個角度看，那棟大樓像一艘巨大的船。

items.passageEn: Our school photo club is very diverse: its members come from many different classes. Our teacher says that good photos are characterized by interesting angles. She taught us to hold the camera steady and to use light properly. For night photos, she showed us how to use a stable stand. We also learned basic camera maintenance. Our club is efficient: we plan each trip in one short meeting. Once, a member laughed at my old camera. I took it as a slight, but later he said sorry, and now we are good friends.
items.passageZh: 我們學校的攝影社非常多元：社員來自許多不同的班級。老師說，好照片的特徵就是有趣的角度。她教我們把相機拿穩，並正確地運用光線。拍夜景時，她示範怎麼用穩固的腳架。我們也學了基本的相機保養。我們社團很有效率：每次出遊只要開一次短會就規劃好了。有一次，一位社員笑我的舊相機。我覺得那是一種輕視，但後來他道了歉，現在我們是好朋友。

questions.questionZh: 拍夜景時老師示範了什麼？
options: 怎麼把閃光燈調到最亮
怎麼找到最好看的月亮
在社團會議上又笑了一次那台相機
道歉，兩人後來成了好朋友
送了一台新相機當作賠禮

items.promptZh: 這家餐廳的客人很多元。
referenceEn: The customers of this restaurant are diverse.
rubricZh: diverse 表示「多元的」，例如 a diverse group 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 這台新冰箱比舊的省電多了。
referenceEn: This new fridge is much more efficient than the old one.
Compared with the old fridge, this new one is much more efficient.
rubricZh: 用 efficient 表示「有效率的；省電的」（例如 much more efficient）
